audio_render_module_tests.build_scope: External harness includes the original audio_render.rs and its out-of-line tests unchanged, with the exact ExportError and PROJECT_CHANNELS definitions from export.rs. Uses production vv-core, vv-audio and vv-media with versions and checksums matched to the source lockfile.

limitations: The full vv-session build reached its own 1280 MiB cgroup limit while compiling tract-core. The one recorded OOM kill was confined to that service, and the full package test target did not run.
The module harness supplies the direct audio regression evidence. It does not cover linking or deploying a current vv-web binary.
The browser coexistence evidence uses the previously qualified runtime and is recorded separately in f7-halo1-aux-r9700-coexistence.json.
